request.query: Roth Lemma 7 supremum index bounded coefficient integer polynomials balanced logarithms

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_bdd_of_roots_le
items.type:
∀ {F : Type u_3} {K : Type u_4} [inst : CommRing F] [inst_1 : NormedField K] {B : ℝ} {d : ℕ} (f : F →+* K)
  {p : Polynomial F},
  p.Monic →
    (Polynomial.map f p).Splits →
      p.natDegree ≤ d →
        (∀ z ∈ (Polynomial.map f p).roots, ‖z‖ ≤ B) →
          ∀ (i : ℕ), ‖(Polynomial.map f p).coeff i‖ ≤ max B 1 ^ d * ↑(d.choose (d / 2))

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_le_of_roots_le
items.type:
∀ {F : Type u_3} {K : Type u_4} [inst : CommRing F] [inst_1 : NormedField K] {p : Polynomial F} {f : F →+* K} {B : ℝ}
  (i : ℕ),
  p.Monic →
    (Polynomial.map f p).Splits →
      (∀ z ∈ (Polynomial.map f p).roots, ‖z‖ ≤ B) →
        ‖(Polynomial.map f p).coeff i‖ ≤ B ^ (p.natDegree - i) * ↑(p.natDegree.choose i)

items.name: Polynomial.supDegree_eq_natDegree
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree id p.toFinsupp = p.natDegree

items.name: MvPolynomial.schwartz_zippel_sup_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      ↑{x ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun i => S i | (MvPolynomial.eval x) p = 0}.card / ∏ i, ↑(S i).card ≤
        p.support.sup fun s => ∑ i, ↑(s i) / ↑(S i).card

items.name: RootPairing.chainTopCoeff_eq_sSup
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {N : Type u_4} [inst : Finite ι] [inst_1 : CommRing R]
  [inst_2 : CharZero R] [inst_3 : IsDomain R] [inst_4 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_5 : Module R M] [inst_6 : AddCommGroup N]
  [inst_7 : Module R N] {P : RootPairing ι R M N} [inst_8 : P.IsCrystallographic] {i j : ι},
  LinearIndependent R ![P.root i, P.root j] →
    RootPairing.chainTopCoeff i j = sSup {k | P.root j + k • P.root i ∈ Set.range ⇑P.root}
